description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.
The IDs of the keys to query.

description.zh: 指定要查询的密钥名称
description.en: The names of the keys to query.

title.zh: 查询后端签名密钥列表

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放API的用户
- 用于查询某Region下的后端签名密钥列表，Region为系统参数
descriptions.en:
- This API is intended for API providers.

- query the backend signature keys in a Region. Region is a system parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-signatures --signature-id dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --signature-name backendsignature --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeSignatures --region cn-hangzhou --SignatureId dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --PageSize 10 --SignatureName backendsignature --PageNumber 1
